title: Move action-type documentation from system prompt into respond_with / tool descriptions
description:
The system prompt in `puppeteer/prompts/default.md` has a block documenting how to respond to each action type (GAME_ASK, GAME_CHOOSE_ABILITY, GAME_CHOOSE_CHOICE, GAME_TARGET). This information would be more effective in `respond_with` strings and/or the `choose_action` MCP tool parameter descriptions, where models see it at decision time rather than buried in the system prompt.

Current state:
- `respond_with` strings are terse: `"choice=N or text=TypeName"`, `"choice=N"`, `"choice=yes or choice=no"`, `"choice=pN"`
- Tool param descriptions are generic: `choice` says `"ID (\"p3\"), index (\"0\"), or yes/no"`, `text` says `"Text value for GAME_CHOOSE_CHOICE (pick option by name)"`
- System prompt has the detailed docs (lines 40-45 of default.md)

Proposed approach:
1. Enrich `respond_with` strings in `BridgeCallbackHandler.java` to include the "not yes/no" warnings and examples, e.g. `"choice=0, choice=1, etc. (not yes/no)"` for GAME_CHOOSE_ABILITY
2. Optionally improve the `choice` and `text` param descriptions in `ChooseActionTool.java` to be more specific per action type
3. Remove or slim down the per-action-type lines in `default.md` once the contextual docs are good enough

Benefit: models get the right guidance exactly when they need it (in the tool call context) rather than having to recall system prompt instructions. This should reduce errors without adding prompt tokens.

Relevant files:
- `Mage.Client.Bridge/src/main/java/mage/client/bridge/BridgeCallbackHandler.java` (respond_with strings)
- `Mage.Client.Bridge/src/main/java/mage/client/bridge/tools/ChooseActionTool.java` (tool param descriptions)
- `puppeteer/prompts/default.md` (system prompt)
